barriers.scope: FOR EACH PRODUCT EDGE xy THE CHECK CIRCUIT CONTAINS A CONSTANT-SIZE AND GADGET JOINING x,y; CONTRACTING GADGETS RECOVERS ARBITRARY G AS A MINOR. THEREFORE NO FIXED UNIVERSAL CIRCUIT TREEWIDTH K.
CURRENT JANUS BOUNDED-ARITY XOR/AND FACTORIZATION. ARITY <=3 AND HYPERTREE WIDTH <=K WOULD IMPLY PRIMAL TREEWIDTH <=3K-1; THE FACTORIZED FAMILY HAS UNBOUNDED PRIMAL TREEWIDTH.

CURRENT JANUS XOR/AND FACTORIZATION. ORIGINAL 3CNF INCIDENCE GRAPH IS A MINOR OF THE FACTORIZED PRIMAL GRAPH AFTER CONTRACTING VARIABLE COHERENCE CHAINS AND CLAUSE-LOCAL GADGETS. 3CNF INCIDENCE TREEWIDTH IS UNBOUNDED, SO NO SINGLE CONSTANT K COVERS THE FULL FAMILY.
EXPLICIT ONE-SELECTOR-PER-CLAUSE COHERENCE. THE SELECTOR FORMULATION IS LINEARLY EQUIVALENT TO 3SAT; THIS DOES NOT BLOCK NONSELECTOR GLOBAL STRUCTURE.

FIXED_FINITE_LOCAL_PP_GADGET CONSTRUCTION ONLY. FULL SIGNED BOOLEAN 3SAT HAS ONLY PROJECTION POLYMORPHISMS, WHILE A TRACTABLE FINITE TEMPLATE REQUIRES NONTRIVIAL TAYLOR/WNU/SIGGERS STRUCTURE. DOES NOT BLOCK GLOBAL INSTANCE-SPECIFIC PREPROCESSING.

INDIVIDUAL RANK-ONE PRODUCT IDENTITIES USED AS THE SOLE CUT CURRENCY, WITH LOCAL AUXILIARIES PROJECTED BACK TO CLAUSE BOUNDARIES. PARTIAL HISTORIES ARE TRUE; COMPLETE SEVEN-CUT CLAUSE HISTORIES ARE EXACT OR3. NONLOCAL GROUPED CUTS OR DIFFERENT REPRESENTATIONS REMAIN OPEN.

ANY SOUND CUT LANGUAGE WHOSE CUTS ARE CLAUSE-LOCAL, WHOSE LOCAL AUXILIARIES ARE EXISTENTIALLY PROJECTED AWAY, AND WHOSE ONLY EXPORTED INTERFACE IS THE ORIGINAL THREE BOOLEAN BOUNDARY VARIABLES. CROSS-CLAUSE OR RICHER-INTERFACE CURRENCIES REMAIN OPEN.

RAIL INSTANTIATIONS WHOSE ABSTRACT STATE IS THE CURRENT F2 MOMENT VECTOR AND WHOSE REFINEMENT CUTS ARE AFFINE F2 EQUATIONS OVER THE SAME COORDINATES. NONLINEAR TRACTABLE CUT LANGUAGES OR REPRESENTATION CHANGES REMAIN OPEN.

authority.source: Kalampakas, Automatic constraints with few subpowers and graphoid recognition, arXiv:2609.07891

barriers.scope: TARGET-SIDE ONLY. FOR FIXED e_p, EVERY e_p-CLOSED AUTOMATIC/COMPACT RELATION POLYNOMIALLY NORMALIZES TO THE FIXED TRACTABLE BASIS Gamma_p. THIS DOES NOT BLOCK AN EXACT COMPILER INTO e_p; IT STATES THAT ALL NEW MATHEMATICS IS IN THE COMPILER ARROW, NOT IN THE e_p LAYER.
SAME e_p COLLAPSE AS ABOVE. A UNIVERSAL EXACT OR3->e_p COMPACT COMPILER WOULD ALREADY CONTAIN THE UNKNOWN GLOBAL MATHEMATICS; e_p NORMALIZATION ITSELF IS NOT THE ESCAPE.
